review.tagline: Local proxy that lets Codex, Claude Code and Grok Build use any LLM
review.summary: opencodex is a local proxy that translates Codex's Responses API into the protocol a chosen provider speaks, covering streaming, tool calls, reasoning tokens and images. It also fronts Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Grok Build, with 40+ built-in providers or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. A web dashboard on port 10100 configures providers, combos with failover, and a ChatGPT account pool with quota-aware routing.
review.audience: Developers who want Codex or Claude Code to run on non-default LLM providers
strengths: 40+ built-in providers plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including Ollama for local models
Combos give one virtual model id with failover or weighted round-robin across providers
Dashboard on localhost:10100 with live request log; `ocx stop` restores original Codex config
Installs via npm with bundled Bun runtime; also desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux
weaknesses: ChatGPT account pooling may conflict with provider terms; README warns of possible enforcement
Desktop app is beta and the Windows .msi is not code-signed
JEV Auto routing is tested only against a mocked endpoint, not a live account
needs: Needs Node 18+, Bun (bundled on npm install)
Models: Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, OpenAI, DeepSeek
